definitions: To stand for or in place of; to act as a delegate or substitute for.
To depict or portray something, especially in a work of art or a description.
To be a symbol or embodiment of; to typify.
To present an image or idea to the mind; to describe or explain.
To constitute or amount to; to be equivalent to.
examples: She will represent the company at the conference.
The artist chose to represent the city at dawn.
These figures represent a significant increase.
